verdict.rationale: First-party docs repeatedly describe DBOS as an "open-source" Postgres-backed library, and its source is published in a public GitHub repo (dbos-inc/dbos-transact-py), so the core product's source is readable. A community comment notes the web UI (Conductor console) has no open-source release, so openness covers the library but not the management tooling. Missing for 10: the specific license is never named in the evidence, the Conductor/console source is not shown to be open, and there is no independent confirmation of the license terms.
